marca.lema: Your cross-border buying and selling agent

inicio.tituloHero: Shop in the U.S., get it wherever you are
inicio.subtituloHero: Mercatren buys for you and sells for you. One place to bring products from the United States, and one place for sellers to reach new countries.

pasos.unoTexto: Browse the stores in our catalog, or ask us for a product from any U.S. store.
pasos.dosTexto: Mercatren places the order on your behalf, receives the package and checks it before shipping.
pasos.tresTexto: We consolidate, ship and keep you posted at every step until the order is in your hands.

inicio.enConstruccion: We're building the catalog. You'll be able to shop here very soon.

noEncontrado.texto: The address doesn't exist, or the product is no longer available.
